- [an.timing.channel](an.timing.channel.html.md): Channel: keyframes for a single (target, property) pair, evaluated at time t.
- [an.timing.clip](an.timing.clip.html.md): Clip: a named bundle of channels with a duration and loop mode.

- [an.timing.easing](an.timing.easing.html.md): The easing registry: every named timing curve, each with the solver that computes it.

- [an.timing.kinds](an.timing.kinds.html.md): Field kinds: the declared interpolator of each animatable property.
- [an.timing.spaces](an.timing.spaces.html.md): Property spaces: what an entity kind’s properties ARE, declared once.
- [an.timing.timeline](an.timing.timeline.html.md): Timeline: tracks of placed clips with absolute times — the compiled evaluation form.
- [an.tools](an.tools.html.md): User-facing utility functions, plus the SSOT list for CLI dispatch.
- [an.util](an.util.html.md): Internal helpers: file I/O, hashing, time arithmetic, light path utilities.
- [an.verify](an.verify.html.md): Verification protocol — same interface for human, lint, vision-LM, MoVer.
- [an.verify.human](an.verify.human.html.md): HumanInTheLoopVerifier — opens the rendered mp4 and asks for approval.
- [an.verify.layout](an.verify.layout.html.md): LayoutLintVerifier — cheap pre-render checks on the IR.
- [an.verify.media](an.verify.media.html.md): Media verification helpers — audio + frame quality checks for rendered mp4s.
- [an.verify.media_quality](an.verify.media_quality.html.md): MediaQualityVerifier — post-render quality checks on the actual mp4.
- [an.verify.prosody](an.verify.prosody.html.md): Prosody measurement: how a recorded voice delivers its words, as numbers a target can check.
- [an.verify.vision](an.verify.vision.html.md): VisionLMVerifier — Claude vision looks at sampled frames and reports issues.

## Optional

- [Top-level llms.txt](../llms.txt): Complete documentation index.
